site_url.description: The website the brief is for, e.g. https://www.example.com.

brand_name.description: The name to end titles with. Empty: taken from the homepage title.

audience.description: Who the site is for, in a sentence. Grounds the wording of titles and descriptions.

focus_keywords.description: Phrases the site should rank for, one per line or comma-separated.

top_n.description: How many actions to write. Default 10.

report_file.description: The PDF a report step (website-seo-report) makes from this brief, e.g. seo-report.pdf. When set, the card's last section points to it.

report_url.description: A link where a person opens this run's files, such as the agent's page in JoyStream. When set, the card's Full report item links to it.
